video_title: Giannis Has 5 Years Left In His Prime, But Miami Has A Problem

quotes.speaker: Channing Frye
quotes.summary_phrase: Channing Frye on the roster needs for the Milwaukee Bucks
quotes.excerpt: They need to find more shooting. You mentioned Brook Lopez, there's a reason why they got Miles Turner.

text_blocks.speaker: Allie Clifton
text_blocks.text: So what do they need to do to round out the roster? Because you were a fan of this move.

text_blocks.speaker: Channing Frye
text_blocks.text: I'm a fan. I think to Channing's point though, they need to find more shooting. You mentioned Brook Lopez, there's a reason why they got Miles Turner. Those are both shooting bigs, very, very good shooting bigs also defensive. Bam has not extended his three-point range quite to that or to the level of Brook and Miles, but that's going to be important. Bam is not a non-shooter. He is not a non-shooter, but that's not his strong point. That's not his area in which he dominates. So, I like the trade. I think Giannis has five more years in his prime, and I say that because he's seven feet tall. So those primes last a little bit longer when you're seven feet tall, because you can't teach that.

quotes.speaker: Richard Jefferson
quotes.summary_phrase: Richard Jefferson on the tactical clash between Miami and Giannis
quotes.excerpt: The way Miami plays basketball is almost the opposite of how Giannis has played basketball his whole career.

text_blocks.speaker: Richard Jefferson
text_blocks.text: The way Miami plays basketball is almost the opposite of how Giannis has played basketball his whole career where the ball is popping, moving, they get down low in the shot clock where Giannis is used to, almost like a Jokic version, five out. I have the ball in the middle.

text_blocks.speaker: Channing Frye
text_blocks.text: They're going to adjust their offense. You asked me a question, they're going to adjust their offense. When you get a certain player, you adjust your offense.

text_blocks.speaker: Richard Jefferson
text_blocks.text: They're going to adjust their offense, Channing, let me just tell you. Like when you get a certain player, you adjust your offense.

quotes.speaker: Channing Frye
quotes.summary_phrase: Channing Frye on the adaptability of great coaching organizations
quotes.excerpt: The thing about having a great coach and a great organization is we adjust to what we have.
quotes.quote: The thing about having a great coach and a great organization is we adjust to what we have. Our style of play is based off of what we have, not this is what we do, this isn't college. We're going to fit into this system and this is who we are. How they played with Shaq and Dwyane Wade was different than how they played with LeBron, D. Wade, and Chris Bosh. It was different. Shaq was still crushing, D. Wade got super hot, but it was how they played with those guys is different than how you played with LeBron, D. Wade, and Chris Bosh. It's different. So how they played with Jimmy Butler is going to be different than how they play with Giannis.

quotes.speaker: Richard Jefferson
quotes.summary_phrase: Richard Jefferson's prediction for the Miami Heat's standing

quotes.speaker: Channing Frye
quotes.summary_phrase: Channing Frye's prediction for the Miami Heat's standing
quotes.quote: Six, seven, eight. Six, seven, eight. Because I think Detroit is going to be good, Boston is going to be good, obviously New York is going to be good, I think Toronto is going to get better. We're still waiting on what's happening with Orlando. We're already at five. I think they finish top four.
